messages:
elaine: FYI saw a jump in fncall validator rejects during the eu-west canary at ~14:07 UTC. hitting customers that call payment_tool. :grimacing:
kiran: are these parse errors or schema strict rejects? any sample log?
elaine: strict rejects. example: validator=v3 fncall=tx42 route=canary-eu reason=MISSING_REQUIRED field=payment.method expected=string got=null
vik: looks like model emitted null for optional vs required fields. fallback kicked in and routed to text-fallback which consumed a lot more tokens.
console-bot: alert: route=canary-eu reject_rate=0.012 fallback_rate=0.18 (14:10 window)
kiran: 1.2% reject is high for canary. what's billing behavior right now when we fallback?
vik: current: final route billed (text-fallback). origin route sees a reject increment but token spend attributed to final route. finance ops complained yesterday about silent cost spikes.
elaine: ops wants: (A) surface both origin and final routes in the console list, (B) emit a reconciliation metric so we can attribute cost back to origin for billing reports.
console-bot: suggestion: add fields fncall.origin_route_id, fncall.final_route_id, fncall.validation.reason_code, fncall.validation.soft_passthrough=true/false. indexable strings preferred.
kiran: +1. Also recommend fncall.dlq_sample_id when we soft-pass so we can pull full payloads for debugging. Increase that sample rate from 0.5% to 10% for this slice.
vik: two action options: 1) soft-pass on validator for canary (tag and continue) 2) block and return error to client 3) rollback model.
elaine: leaning to (1) with strong tagging so customers stay up, but must ensure we don't accidentally let quota bypass happen.
kiran: if soft-pass is on, we should increment origin_route.token_charge metric and emit fncall.cost.reconciliation{origin,final}. Blindly billing final route without reconciliation will break quota enforcement.
vik: technically we can emit a reconciliation record to billing pipeline; finance agreed to a reconciliation field. but we need to be careful about double counting in dashboards.
elaine: console change: show a small orange badge next to routes in rollout view when soft-pass is active and a column "attributed_origin" in the cost table. I'll add a quick mock and toggle.
console-bot: note: add alert rule: when reject_rate > 0.5% AND fallback_rate > 15% during a rollout window => create incident and attach runbook 'fncall-schema-rollout'.
kiran: I'll draft a short RFC for telemetry names and a migration plan for old indices. planning tests for enum coercion and nullable handling in validator v3.
auditor-bot: audit log: canary-eu rollout toggled to soft-pass=false at 14:25 by deploy-bot.
vik: thanks. assigning owners: kiran for telemetry/RFC, elaine for console badges + alert, me for short-term soft-pass toggle + DLQ sample bump.
elaine: will update the rollout doc with recommended conservative schema checks for canaries.
kiran: will follow up with billing to ensure reconciliation pipeline patch is scheduled tomorrow.
elaine: good. post-mortem check 14:40 PT. thanks team :thumbsup:
